name: moto-warranty-triage
description: Warranty claims API that runs a Python triage agent as a retried, idempotent background job
author: Khanh Vuong Tuan

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:py
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.eval: cd ai-service && uv run --frozen python -m triage_service.evals
scripts.record:fixtures: cd ai-service && uv run --frozen python -m triage_service.record_fixtures
